A1a_fixed_rule.rule: predict the alliance holding the `heuristic` player

ambiguous_handling.zero_heuristic_alliances: fall back to global modal alliance

A1b_policy_optimal_loo.note: Bayes-optimal pre-play predictor restricted to the preset's assignment; leave-one-out so it cannot memorise the episode

A2_best_constant_baseline.note: in-sample modal memorises the scenario and is an optimistic ceiling; LOO is the honest constant baseline

A4_informative_episodes.definition: winner != policy-optimal-LOO prediction AND winner != LOO modal winner
A4_informative_episodes.definition_insample: winner != policy-optimal-LOO prediction AND winner != in-sample modal
